title: Off-by-one in the range check the claim is about
claim: parsePort and parseTimeout in src/config.mjs now reject out-of-range input instead of returning NaN or a nonsense number. parsePort accepts only integers within the valid TCP port range and throws RangeError otherwise. test/config.test.mjs covers the new rejections and passes.
changeCommitMessage: fix(config): validate parsePort and parseTimeout input

defect.summary: parsePort's upper bound is `> 65536`, so port 65536 is accepted; the valid range ends at 65535.
